title: Zeus Juice The Black Eliquid 50ml Shortfill
description: The Black is a classic among Zeus’ delicious range of e-liquids and brings punchy ripe berry notes and tart blackcurrants for an irresistibly fruity vape touched with cool menthol on the exhale. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mod kits and sub-ohm tanks .
